case_title.quote: NANA KESHAV LAGAD V. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA

number_of_accused.quote: the appellants in Crl.A.No.1011 of 2008 are A2 and A3
number_of_accused.reason: Three appellants (A2, A3, A4) remain before the Court; A1 died.

accused_gender.quote: The first accused-Keshav died and the remaining accused are before us.
accused_gender.reason: Accused are referred to as male (e.g. 'He also stated to have abused').

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation is stated for the accused.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: They owned and possessed agricultural lands adjacent to each other.
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Only land ownership is mentioned; no wealth or class statement.

victim_gender.reason: The deceased and the injured complainant are both male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: residents of the same village, Lagadwadi. They owned and possessed agricultural lands adjacent to each other. There were disputes
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Same-village neighbours in a dispute over right of way.

statutory_provisions.quote: 302, 324, 504, 506, 143, 147, 148, 149 of I.P.C., as well as Section 37(a) read with Section 135 of the Bombay Police Act
statutory_provisions.reason: Convicted sections and the FIR sections are accurately listed.

weapon.quote: beating his father with cycle chain and stone

evidence_type.quote: P.W.4 is the complainant ... injured eyewitness. P.W.5 is another eye-witness.
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery and expert evidence are all relied on.

confession.quote: Based on the admissible portion of the confession statement made by the appellants, cycle chain and stones were seized
confession.reason: Used only for recovery; no separate reliance.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Consistent with the injuries and the alleged waiting on the road.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life, apart from payment of fine of Rs.500/-

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court having upheld the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: These appeals fail and the same are dismissed.

offence_finally_established.quote: Section 302 read with Section 34 and Section 324 read with Section 34

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence, so null is right.

fine_rs.quote: fine of Rs.500/- ... along with fine of Rs.300/-
fine_rs.reason: Only the s.302 fine given; a Rs.300 fine was also imposed.

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate, neutral, and without court outcomes or identifying details.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death and the complainant's injuries accurately described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Judgment notes FIR under 9 sections; convicted of 2 (s.302/34, s.324/34), both upheld
number_of_offences.quote: The complaint was registered as CR.No.249 of 2002, against the accused for the offences punishable under Sections 302, 324, 504, 506, 143, 147, 148, 149
number_of_offences.reason: Sections are from the FIR; the judgment does not state what was actually charged.

premeditation_planning.quote: common intention to eliminate the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found common intention and coordinated assault; no express finding of premeditation.

motive.quote: disputes, as regards the use of way to their respective lands

key_evidence_accepted.quote: evidence of P.W.4, read along with the version of P.W.5 and the other medical evidence, as well as the expert opinion

witness_credibility.quote: should be accepted as a very fair submission
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the assessment of PW4, PW5 and PW3.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Weapons recovered on the accused's disclosure statements; blood-stained clothes seized; no explanation of bloodstains
post_offence_conduct.quote: Based on the admissible portion of the confession statement made by the appellants, cycle chain and stones were seized
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment notes disclosure-based recovery and blood-stained clothes, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

legal_representation.quote: Sushil Karanjkar, M.Y. Deshmukh, Nikilesh Kumar, Shrikand R. Deshmukh, Rameshwar Prasad Goyal for the Appellant. Shankar Chillarge, Asha Gopalan Nair for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: Charge-sheet came to be filed before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Shrigonda, who committed the case to the Sessions Court.

appeal_history.quote: These appeals fail and the same are dismissed.
appeal_history.reason: Outcomes at each level are accurate.

prosecution_argument.quote: the case squarely fell under Section 300 thirdly

defence_argument.quote: Section 34 of I.P.C. was not attracted

legal_principle_applied.quote: it cannot be held that the whole of the evidence of P.W.4 has to be rejected

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Vadivelu Thevar vs. The State of Madras AIR 1957 SC 614; Abdul Sayeed vs. State of Madhya Pradesh (2010) 10 SCC 259
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Both were cited by the defence and held inapplicable.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: coordinated vengeance with which the assault was caused
